The staff was helpful in explaining the available models and suggesting options within my budget. They have a decent range of basic and mid-range cycles, especially for daily commuting and general use.

The delivery was quick, and the cycle was assembled on the spot. However, I did notice that minor adjustments in gear shifting and brakes were required after a few days, which is quite common but worth mentioning.

Pricing is reasonable compared to other local shops, and being an authorised dealer gives some confidence regarding product authenticity.

Overall, a good place if you’re looking for an affordable, no-frills bicycle, but for premium or performance bikes, you may need to explore other stores.

The Triumph Daytona 660 arrived in the FIM Sportbike World Championship with promise.
At Misano, it delivered history.
After a season of increasingly strong performances, Bruno Ieraci guided the Daytona 660 from seventh on the grid to victory, securing the motorcycle’s first World Championship win and Triumph’s place on the top step of the podium.
A milestone moment for the Daytona 660, and a powerful statement of our vision for the future and the capability that Triumph’s refined engineering brings to the track.
[Triumph motorcycles, Triumph India, FIM Sportbike World Championship, Victory, Misano, Daytona 660, Performance, Racing, Engineering excellence, For those who know the difference, For the ride] See less

Not every day you find yourself standing a few feet away from a 1939 Triumph.
At World of Triumph Siliguri, we’re bringing together four machines that helped shape over a century of motorcycling.
The 1939 Triumph 3HW, developed for military service during World War II.
The 1945 Triumph 3T Twin, marking a new chapter as the world emerged from war.
The 1948 Triumph Speed Twin, the motorcycle that redefined the modern parallel-twin.
The 1955 Triumph Tiger 100, one of the most celebrated performance motorcycles of its era.
Motorcycles that didn’t inherit a legacy, but played a pivotal role in creating one.
See them up close at World of Triumph Siliguri, and immerse yourself in the iconic motorcycling world that’s led by legacy.

featured_reviews.name: Atul Deshmukh
featured_reviews.review_text:
When I first started planning an upgrade from my 250cc motorcycle to the 390–450cc segment, Triumph Motorcycles was already at the top of my list. I decided to walk into the Triumph South Mumbai showroom to explore my options — and what followed turned out to be a truly memorable buying experience.

From the very first interaction, the team was extremely welcoming and approachable. I was assisted by Kerfegar Modi, Mrunmay Mestry, Rahul Dabholkar, and Shubham Gala, and every single one of them was enthusiastic, knowledgeable, and always ready to help. What stood out immediately was their patience. They clearly understand that many customers walking into a Triumph showroom are upgrading in terms of engine capacity and may have plenty of doubts and questions. At no point did they make me feel uncomfortable for asking basic or detailed questions — instead, they invested time in making sure everything was explained clearly.

My journey with the bikes themselves was quite interesting. I originally walked in with the intention of buying the Triumph Speed 400, mainly because I had liked it since its launch. I had never ridden an ADV or scrambler before, so the Triumph Scrambler 400 X felt slightly intimidating to me. During my very first test ride I even had a small mishap, but the team handled the situation with complete support and understanding, ensuring that it never became an issue.

Over time, I ended up taking three separate test rides, and every time the team welcomed the request without hesitation. They allowed me to take my time, understand the motorcycle properly, and make my decision with clarity. For the first ride, they even allowed me a longer test ride distance than usual after I explained my hesitation about riding a scrambler. That extra opportunity made a huge difference — without it, I might have simply gone ahead with the Speed 400 instead of discovering how capable and enjoyable the Scrambler actually was.

What impressed me most about the showroom was the overall approach of the team. The space itself is clean, premium, and accessible without feeling intimidating, and the staff maintains a very welcoming atmosphere. More importantly, there was absolutely no pressure selling. Instead of trying to push a motorcycle, the team focused on helping me understand which bike would suit me best.

The booking and delivery process was equally smooth. The team delivered exactly what they promised and managed everything professionally. When the day finally came to take delivery of my Scrambler 400 X, I felt both ecstatic and responsible at the same time. The delivery was very well organized, and the team allowed me to truly take in the moment rather than rushing through the process.

I would 100% recommend Triumph South Mumbai, especially because of the people there. Kerfegar Modi, Mrunmay Mestry, Rahul Dabholkar, and Shubham Gala strike the perfect balance between professionalism and empathy. Their guidance, personal insights, and encouragement helped me overcome my initial doubts and ultimately made the entire journey of choosing and buying my motorcycle a genuinely enjoyable experience.

And now, every time I take the Scrambler 400 X out for a ride around Mumbai, it reminds me that I made the right decision — both in choosing the motorcycle and the team that helped me get there.
